hints: Write cos4x=1−2sin²2x and then sin2x=2sinx cosx.
Replace cos²x by 1−sin²x, expand, and collect powers of sinx to reach the stated expression.
walkthrough:
Express $\cos(4x)$ using the double-angle identity $\cos(2\theta) = 1 - 2\sin^2\theta$ with $\theta = 2x$:
$$\cos(4x) = 1 - 2\sin^2(2x)$$

Substitute the double-angle formula $\sin(2x) = 2\sin x\cos x$:
$$\sin^2(2x) = (2\sin x\cos x)^2 = 4\sin^2 x\cos^2 x$$
$$\cos(4x) = 1 - 2\left(4\sin^2 x\cos^2 x\right) = 1 - 8\sin^2 x\cos^2 x$$

Use the Pythagorean identity $\cos^2 x = 1 - \sin^2 x$ to express everything in terms of $\sin x$:
$$\cos(4x) = 1 - 8\sin^2 x\left(1 - \sin^2 x\right) = 1 - 8\sin^2 x + 8\sin^4 x$$

Substitute this expression for $\cos(4x)$ into the left-hand side:
$$\cos(4x) + 2\sin^2 x - 1 = \left(1 - 8\sin^2 x + 8\sin^4 x\right) + 2\sin^2 x - 1$$
$$= 8\sin^4 x + (-8\sin^2 x + 2\sin^2 x) + (1 - 1)$$
$$= 8\sin^4 x - 6\sin^2 x$$

hints: Use part (a) and factor 8sin⁴x−6sin²x as sin²x(8sin²x−6).
Solve both factors in degrees across −180°≤x≤180°, including the endpoints and every quadrant solution.
walkthrough:
Replace the left-hand side with the identity established in part (a):
$$8\sin^4 x - 6\sin^2 x = 0$$
$$2\sin^2 x\left(4\sin^2 x - 3\right) = 0$$
$$\sin^2 x = 0 \quad \text{or} \quad 4\sin^2 x - 3 = 0$$

Solve the first branch $\sin^2 x = 0 \implies \sin x = 0$ for $-180^\circ \leqslant x \leqslant 180^\circ$:
$$x = -180^\circ, \quad x = 0^\circ, \quad x = 180^\circ$$

Solve the second branch $4\sin^2 x - 3 = 0$:
$$\sin^2 x = \dfrac{3}{4} \implies \sin x = \pm\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$$
$$\text{Basic angle: } \alpha = \sin^{-1}\left(\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right) = 60^\circ$$

Find all solutions for $\sin x = +\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$ and $\sin x = -\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$ in $[-180^\circ, 180^\circ]$:
$$\text{For } \sin x = +\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}: \quad x = 60^\circ, \quad x = 180^\circ - 60^\circ = 120^\circ$$
$$\text{For } \sin x = -\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}: \quad x = -60^\circ, \quad x = -180^\circ - (-60^\circ) = -120^\circ$$

Combine and order all 7 distinct solutions:
$$x = -180^\circ, \; -120^\circ, \; -60^\circ, \; 0^\circ, \; 60^\circ, \; 120^\circ, \; 180^\circ$$
